name: branding-maze-grid-wordmark-restaurant
title: Pixel-maze wordmark on wrappers and kraft bags
whatItIs: A black wordmark built from rectangular strokes and dots, forming a maze-like lettering of 'bemeals' between two heavy bars. It is applied on a sandwich wrapper on dark wood and reversed out of a kraft paper bag against terracotta tiles.
whatItMeans: Bold, codelike and playful, with a puzzle quality that invites a second look.
techniques: Construct every letter from a square grid so the word looks like a maze or barcode.
Frame the word between heavy horizontal bars for a stamp-like lockup.
Use it as a repeating band on packaging.
Show positive and reversed versions on contrasting materials.
bestFor: Tech and design brands wanting a codelike mark
Brands that work as stamps or labels

vocabulary.definition: Letters built on a square module.
A logo arranged like a rubber stamp.
A logo in light on dark.
A logo repeated as a stripe across packaging.
